sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch; body attitude is explicitly illustrative.
provenance.qualification: Computed LINEAR Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. A smooth approximation of LINEAR’s published radar dimensions. The measurements constrain its size, but do not supply a detailed surface model. The grid marks absent surface photographs; the orientation is illustrative.
